channel.title: shadcn/ui Changelog
channel.description: Composable, accessible components with thoughtful defaults. Build your own component library with code you can customize, extend, and make your own.

item.title: September 2026 - cn
item.description: Components now import cn from the cn package. One dependency instead of two, and no local helper to maintain.

item.title: August 2026 - Private GitHub Registries
item.description: Install registry items from private GitHub repositories using the GitHub CLI or a token.

item.title: August 2026 - Human in the Loop
item.description: Mock paused tool calls, approvals, and continuations for the AI SDK with @shadcn/helpers.

item.title: August 2026 - Questionnaire
item.description: A new component for building multi-step question flows with fixed, freeform, multiple, and skippable answers.

item.title: July 2026 - Dynamic Search
item.description: Registries can now handle search server-side.

item.title: July 2026 - Toast
item.description: A new Toast component built on Base UI primitives.

item.title: July 2026 - React Aria
item.description: React Aria is now available as a component base in shadcn/ui.

item.title: July 2026 - Introducing @shadcn/helpers
item.description: Small, focused helpers for developing apps, starting with AI SDK and TanStack AI.

item.title: July 2026 - Introducing shadcn/typeset
item.description: A complete typography system for HTML, from blog posts to streaming chat. One CSS file you own.

item.title: July 2026 - Base UI as the Default
item.description: New projects now use Base UI by default. Radix is still fully supported.

item.title: June 2026 - Components for Chat Interfaces
item.description: MessageScroller, Message, Bubble, Attachment, and Marker. Components for building chat interfaces.

item.title: June 2026 - GitHub Registries
item.description: Turn any public GitHub repository into a shadcn registry.

item.title: May 2026 - shadcn eject
item.description: Inline shadcn/tailwind.css and remove the shadcn dependency.

item.title: May 2026 - Introducing Rhea
item.description: A more compact Luma. Smaller spacing. Denser surfaces. Built for focused product interfaces.

item.title: May 2026 - Registry Include and Validate
item.description: Organize and validate source registries.

item.title: May 2026 - Package Imports and Target Aliases
item.description: Configure shadcn/ui with package.json imports and portable registry target aliases.

item.title: April 2026 - shadcn preset
item.description: Decode, share, open, and resolve preset codes from the shadcn CLI.

item.title: April 2026 - Pointer Cursor
item.description: Add cursor pointer behavior for buttons during project setup.

item.title: April 2026 - Partial Preset Apply
item.description: Apply only the theme or fonts from a preset while keeping your existing components.

item.title: April 2026 - Introducing Sera
item.description: Minimal. Editorial. Typographic. Underline Controls and Uppercase Headings. Shaped by Print Design Principles.

item.title: April 2026 - shadcn apply
item.description: Switch presets in existing projects without starting over.

item.title: April 2026 - Component Composition
item.description: Composition sections across component pages—structured trees that help you and your agents build correct UI.

item.title: March 2026 - Introducing Luma
item.description: Rounded geometry. Soft elevation. Breathable layouts. Inspired by macOS Tahoe, minus the glass.

item.title: March 2026 - shadcn/cli v4
item.description: More capable, easier to use. Built for you and your coding agents. Skills, presets, dry run, new templates, monorepo and more.

item.title: February 2026 - Blocks for Radix and Base UI
item.description: All blocks are now available for both Radix and Base UI.

item.title: February 2026 - Unified Radix UI Package
item.description: The new-york style now uses the unified radix-ui package.

item.title: January 2026 - RTL Support
item.description: The shadcn CLI now supports RTL (right-to-left) layouts by automatically converting physical CSS classes to logical equivalents.

item.title: January 2026 - Inline Start and End Styles
item.description: We've updated the styles for Base UI components to support inline-start and inline-end side values.

item.title: January 2026 - Base UI Documentation
item.description: Full documentation for Base UI components.

item.title: December 2025 - npx shadcn create
item.description: Customize everything. Pick your component library, icons, base color, theme, fonts and create your own version of shadcn/ui.

item.title: October 2025 - Registry Directory
item.description: A list of code registries you can browse and pull code and components from.

item.title: October 2025 - New Components
item.description: Spinner, Kbd, Button Group, Input Group, Field, Item, and Empty components.

item.title: September 2025 - Registry Index
item.description: An index of open source registries that you can install items from.

item.title: August 2025 - shadcn CLI 3.0 and MCP Server
item.description: Namespaced registries, advanced authentication, new commands and a completely rewritten registry engine.

item.title: July 2025 - Universal Registry Items
item.description: Create registry items that can be distributed to any project.

item.title: July 2025 - Local File Support
item.description: Initialize projects and add components from local JSON files.

item.title: June 2025 - radix-ui Migration
item.description: A new command to migrate to the new radix-ui package.

item.title: June 2025 - Calendar Component
item.description: Upgraded Calendar component with React DayPicker and 30+ calendar blocks.

item.title: May 2025 - New Site
item.description: Upgraded ui.shadcn.com to Next.js 15.3 and Tailwind v4.

item.title: April 2025 - MCP
item.description: Zero-config MCP support for shadcn/ui registry.

item.title: April 2025 - shadcn 2.5.0
item.description: Resolve anywhere - registries can now place files anywhere in an app.

item.title: April 2025 - Cross-framework Route Support
item.description: The shadcn CLI can now auto-detect your framework and adapt routes for you.

item.title: February 2025 - Tailwind v4
item.description: First preview of Tailwind v4 and React 19 support.

item.title: February 2025 - Updated Registry Schema
item.description: Updated registry schema to support more features.

item.title: January 2025 - Blocks Community
item.description: Inviting the community to contribute to the blocks library.

item.title: December 2024 - Monorepo Support
item.description: New monorepo support in the CLI.

item.title: November 2024 - Icons
item.description: The new-york style now uses Lucide as the default icon set.

item.title: October 2024 - React 19
item.description: shadcn/ui is now compatible with React 19 and Next.js 15.

item.title: October 2024 - Sidebar
item.description: 25 components to help you build all kinds of sidebars.

item.title: August 2024 - npx shadcn init
item.description: Complete CLI rewrite with support for all major React frameworks.

item.title: April 2024 - Lift Mode
item.description: A new mode for Blocks to lift smaller components for copy and paste.

item.title: March 2024 - Introducing Blocks
item.description: Ready-made components for dashboards and authentication pages.

item.title: March 2024 - Breadcrumb and Input OTP
item.description: New Breadcrumb and Input OTP components.

item.title: December 2023 - New Components
item.description: Carousel, Drawer, Pagination, Resizable, Sonner, and CLI updates.

item.title: July 2023 - JavaScript
item.description: JavaScript version of components available via the CLI.

item.title: June 2023 - New CLI, Styles and more
item.description: Complete CLI rewrite with new styles, theming options, and more.
